name: Neutral
desc: The starting position. Every encounter begins here, and every plain swing returns here.

name: Coiled
desc: Wind-up position. Entered by Gather and Ginga; Heavy Blow and other heavy techniques start from here.

name: Extended
desc: Reach position. Entered by Lunge, Riposte and Crosscut; Thrust starts from here.

name: Off Balance
desc: Incoming damage ×1.15 while here. Left in it by Heavy Blow, Weapon Drop and Overwhelming forks; Ginga and Meia Lua start from here.

name: Guarded
desc: Incoming damage ×0.9 while here. Entered by Sidestep and Clinch Knee; Flowing Shield and Electric Cross start from here.

name: Spell Ready
desc: Holds a readied spell. Incoming damage ×1.1 while here. Entered by Ready Spell; Spell Parry starts from here. Leaving it by any other move drops the spell.

name: Wide Open
desc: Incoming damage ×1.2 while here. Entered by Taunt, Impaling Swing and Exposing forks; German Suplex and Flesh Draw start from here.
